skill.summary: Toolkit for styling artifacts with a theme. These artifacts can be slides, docs, reportings, HTML landing pages, etc. There are 10 pre-set themes with colors...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Theme Factory skill.
- Provides 10 pre-set professional themes for consistent styling of slides, documents, reports, and HTML pages.
- Allows users to preview themes in a showcase PDF and select their preferred option for application.
- Supports custom theme creation with tailored fonts and color palettes based on user input.
- Ensures all themes feature cohesive color palettes, complementary font pairings, and distinct visual identities.
